chunks: Except to the path of Hell, where they will abide eternally; and that is for Allah an easy matter.

key_terms.طَرِيقَ جَهَنَّمَ: The path or way to Hell
key_terms.يَسِيرًا: Easy or effortless (referring to Allah's power)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by the 'path of Hell' and its eternity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the inevitability of divine decree for those who follow the 'path of Hell,' emphasizing that eternal punishment is not burdensome to Allah but a natural consequence of straying. The phrase 'easy for Allah' (على الله يسيرا) underscores His absolute power to enact justice without effort, reinforcing the concept of divine omnipotence in the distribution of reward and punishment.
